required_condition: local metric variation must reduce to EH plus allowed Lambda/boundary terms
why_it_matters: without this the exterior field equation may simply not be GR

required_condition: T_projector must be zero, pure gauge, boundary-only conserved, or retained explicitly
why_it_matters: dropping this would fake an EH exterior and break Bianchi safety

required_condition: G_eff M_eff must be constant, universal, range-independent, species-independent
why_it_matters: Newtonian mechanics needs source normalization, not just EH-shaped algebra

required_condition: ordinary matter/clocks/rulers factor through one observed local quotient/coframe
why_it_matters: WEP/clock/source charge silence remains closure otherwise

required_condition: worldtube/linking-sphere/boundary terms have no local mass/PPN flux
why_it_matters: hidden boundary charge can contaminate GM and PPN

required_condition: gamma-1, beta-1, alpha_i, xi, Gdot/G, clock/WEP residuals are zero or bounded
why_it_matters: requires EH/source/projector gates first to avoid meaningless coefficients

required_condition: finite trace alpha has no valid theory row; other finite modes require source rows
why_it_matters: important empirically, but not the next derivation gate
